title: Finch: browse to reflection
role_for_mira: Emotional pacing for Talk, Activities, and Journal; browse-to-write structure.

target_reference.units: logical design units, not measured donor dp

spatial_ergonomic.measurement_basis: Qualitative visual reading of retained frames. Regions below are relative roles; source screenshots/GIFs do not expose device density or reliable native dp. Marketing/device chrome is not counted as app content.

regions.description: Top: return affordance; center: large character scene; lower-middle: labeled activity choices.
Top: category identity; center/lower: repeated prompt rows; free-form choice remains visible.
Top: date and one question; center: open writing; lower-middle: Cancel and Done.
Background context remains visible behind a distinct reward sheet.

spatial_ergonomic.reference_zone_status: Proposed comparison grid only; donor controls may fall outside these bands. Not a fixed-coordinate implementation rule.

visual_density.value: Hub: medium; prompt list: high; editor: low; receipt: medium.

transitions.trigger: Choose a prompt or free form

states_and_triggers.limitation: Visible states are observations; documented arrows use source flow/guide descriptions. No event-handler names, gesture thresholds, or unseen screens are inferred as measured behavior.

observation.value: Still captures establish different screens/sheets, not transition timing, easing, or whether the keyboard was dismissed between frames.

visual_or_documented_feedback.value: The reward is visibly illustrated. Sound and haptic behavior are not captured.

hierarchy.value: A single specific question leads the editor; labeled choices precede it. The list is text-dense compared with the editor. A celebration is a separate state, not part of the writing prompt.

copy_and_cognitive_load.note: No OCR word-count or grade-level measurement is claimed. Use the Mira copy sheet for exact comparison text.

mira_synthesis_candidate.value: Use a coherent character/illustration world, then prioritize the current action. Keep existing activity categories and Journal entry paths. Acknowledgment can be satisfying without adding a reward currency or attendance requirement.
